title: Fourteen Autumns and One Short Bill
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术）　|　核心词汇：domain　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 domain 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1996 my teacher ① registered a domain that no colleague in the lab would have paid for, and he said the registering was the whole of the autumn. The ② domain, meaning the name and not the estate, ran fourteen autumns and stayed unnamed in the book; a domain, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unused.

Every ③ domain in that lab had the same short bill at the end of it, and the ④ domain at the end, meaning the one they kept for the graduate students and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A domain, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to renew; my teacher said the renewing is the part that fills fourteen autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the domain was the whole of the story, meaning the estate and not the name. The ⑥ domain, meaning the estate and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody fights for and nobody manages; domain, he said, is either something you register or the only word that means both a name and an estate. He said the estate is the part they remember.

By 2005 the ⑦ domain had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short bill. The ⑧ domain of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in October, was one lab and fourteen autumns of renewing; domain, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to renew. She said the renewing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ domain I remember is the one named in the register, which expired in 2017 and is still described as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ domain, my mother said in 2019, is the only one that improves by being renewed; every domain, she said, is an estate that has agreed to look like a name. She said the estate was the honest half.

task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 域名；领域（指那间实验室里注册的那一个）
B. n. 域名；领域（指那个名称本身，与领地相对）
C. 固定搭配：register a domain 注册一个域名
D. n. 域名；领域（指留给研究生用的那一个）
E. n. 域名；领域（抽象总称，指一个团队的域名之事）
F. n. 域名；领域（指备案清单上写到、被列名的那一个）
G. n. 领地；地产（指故事里人人争夺却无人管理的那一片）
H. n. 领地（抽象总称，指人人争夺却无人管理的那种东西）

answers.why: register a domain 意为“注册一个域名”，1996 年老师注册了一个实验室里没有一位同事肯为之付钱的域名。
domain 意为“域名、领域”，指那个名称本身而不是领地，它经过了十四个秋天而在簿子上没有被记名。
domain 意为“域名、领域”，指那间实验室里的每一个域名，每一个到头来都有同一张短短的账单。
domain 意为“域名、领域”，指留给研究生用的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
domain 意为“领地、地产”，指故事里人人争夺却无人管理的那一片，叔叔说这片领地就是那个故事的全部。
domain 意为“领地”，指人人争夺却无人管理的那种东西而不是那个名称，是故事里人人都争、却无人管理的东西。
domain 意为“域名、领域”，指备案清单上写到、被列名的那一个，到 2005 年这个域名成了备案清单里的一行。
domain 意为“域名、领域”，老师十月写道，整件事的域名之事是一间实验室和十四个秋天的续费。
domain 意为“域名、领域”，我记得的是备案清单上列名的那一个，2017 年到期了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一个。
domain 为抽象总称，母亲 2019 年说，一个域名是唯一会因为被好好续费而变得更好的东西。
